full_judgment: 14. In course of trial plaintiffs examined four witnesses, of them PW 1 Serajid Islam (Plaintiff No. 1) who stated that their Predecessor got the suit land by settlement through dakhila dated 10-10-1950 BS (Exhibits 2 and 6) and they as heirs possessing the land by cultivating seasonal vegetables. In cross-examination he stated that he has no knowledge who wrote dakhila and in suit land there was a hospital and Government possessed the same but it is not acted upon, medicines were supplied from hospital. PW 2 Abdur Rahim PW 3 Shahidul Islam, PW4 Tajul Islam are local witnesses, they were examined to corroborate the evidence of PW 1. They failed to state anything regarding dakhila dated 10-10-1050 BS and failed to prove the possession of plaintiffs by corroborative evidence. Defendant examined five witnesses, of them DW 1 Shahidul Islam (defendant No. 5), local Tahsilder, who categorically stated that total area of land in plot No. 962 is 0.97 acres, which was belonged to Kali Prasanna and others while they were in possession it was acquired by Government in LA Case No. 11 of 1921-22 (Exhibit ক) Eventually they withdrew the compensation awarded to them (Exhibit খ) and same was published in official gazette (Exhibit গ) and Map (Exhibit ঘ). Now the suit land stand in the name of the Government in Khas Khatian. He added that in suit land there was a Charitable dispensary maintained by District Council. Beside, its there is a Thana Health Complex. The possession of the plaintiffs by cultivating vegetables is not correct DW 2 Md Shah Alam, DW 3 Md Abdur Rahman, DW 4 Haji Abdus Sattar, DW 5 Bishnu Kumar Bhattarcharjee are independent witnesses. They in one voice corroborated the evidence of DW 1 regarding Charitable dispensary situated in suit land.
